statement: Systematically probing secondary provider fallback behavior under simulated failure will reveal hidden latent capability bounds (K) and relational usage (R) not captured by standard generational success counts.
proposed_experiment: Execute a provider_probe experiment targeting huggingface to test fallback robustness and measure functional state distinctions (Z).
expected_evidence: Clear transition telemetry documenting fallback handling or failure logging, yielding an updated observable profile for Z and R.

statement: By establishing a structured taxonomy for internally generated epistemic questions based on FZG profile constraints, Ubique can systematically formulate multi-step experimental plans that increase functionally retained capability (K) across distinct conceptual domains.
proposed_experiment: Design and execute an internal memory recall experiment targeting abstract memory compression rules, evaluating whether synthesized concept hierarchies improve subsequent hypothesis generation confidence.
expected_evidence: A structured set of compressed memory abstractions yielding measurable changes in subsequent hypothesis novelty scores and confidence metrics.

hypothesis: By establishing a structured taxonomy for internally generated epistemic questions based on FZG profile constraints, Ubique can systematically formulate multi-step experimental plans that increase functionally retained capability (K) across distinct conceptual domains.

statement: Injecting synthesized concept hierarchies into the hypothesis generation prompt structure will increase the functional solution path count (L) and maintain higher confidence intervals across novel non-maintenance reasoning tasks.
proposed_experiment: Execute a bounded state consistency experiment measuring the divergence of newly generated hypotheses with and without prior memory abstraction injections.
expected_evidence: Quantifiable divergence metrics demonstrating increased vocabulary richness and structural novelty in hypotheses generated under memory abstraction conditions compared to baseline controls.

hypothesis: Injecting synthesized concept hierarchies into the hypothesis generation prompt structure will increase the functional solution path count (L) and maintain higher confidence intervals across novel non-maintenance reasoning tasks.

statement: Structuring memory abstractions into recursive hierarchical trees rather than flat concept lists will improve the precision of G_A estimation by isolating independent causal levers during counterfactual intervention experiments.
proposed_experiment: Execute a hypothesis_ablation experiment comparing flat concept injection versus hierarchical concept tree injection, measuring the resulting variance in causal effect estimation across identical counterfactual test prompts.
expected_evidence: Hierarchical injection will yield lower variance and cleaner causal separation in counterfactual attribution compared to flat injection.
